description: Client-side script managing navigation menu toggle, header background change on scroll, active link highlighting based on scroll position, and portfolio item filtering.

methods.name: linkAction
methods.description: Removes 'show-menu' class from navigation menu when a navigation link is clicked.

methods.name: scrollHeader
methods.description: Adds or removes 'scroll-header' class to header element based on scroll position.

methods.name: navHighLighter
methods.description: Highlights the active navigation link based on current scroll position within sections.
